Here is the comprehensive list of execution tools mentioned or used in the workflows:

**AI Models & Generation Tools:**
- fal.ai
- Vercel AI Gateway
- Nano Banana (Gemini 3 Pro Image)
- Flux 1.1 Pro
- Flux Schnell
- Midjourney v7
- DALL-E 3
- Ideogram
- Kling 3.0
- Kling Turbo 2.6
- Wan 2.2
- Minimax Speech-02 HD
- F5-TTS
- ElevenLabs API
- HeyGen API (Avatar III / IV / V, talking-photo)
- Hedra Character-3
- Hallo3
- Suno v5.5
- Claude

**Video/Image Editing & Frameworks:**
- Remotion (including Remotion Studio, @remotion/cli, @remotion/renderer, @remotion/transitions, @remotion/captions, @remotion/media-utils, @remotion/shapes, @remotion/compositor-linux-x64-musl)
- React
- react-dom
- TypeScript
- GIMP
- cli-anything-gimp
- Pillow
- numpy
- Sharp
- Canvas

**Audio & Music Libraries:**
- Epidemic Sound
- Artlist
- Splice
- Soundsnap
- freesound.org

**Analytics & Platform Tools:**
- vidIQ (vidIQ Pro)
- Spotter Studio
- YouTube Studio Analytics
- YouTube Native A/B testing (Test & Compare)

**CLI, Scripts & System Tools:**
- Python (3.10+)
- pip
- requests (Python library)
- bash
- curl
- jq

**Agent Tools & Commands:**
- present (tool)
- ask_user (tool)
- read_skill (tool)
- checklist verbs
- viral-database (skill/tool)
